page: Microsoft Azure F80ads_v7 is a high-compute virtual machine instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V45 processor. Built on the x86_64 architecture, it features 80 dedicated physical cores and 80 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 320.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes a substantial local NVMe storage allocation of 9449 GB and supports Premium Storage. The hypervisor layer is managed by Microsoft Hyper-V.

Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier (top 10%) for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance via stress-ng, as well as PassMark CPU testing. Memory bandwidth is exceptionally high, with cached read-only small block speeds reaching 14260.32 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 213.34 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations also perform in the top 10% tier, executing 202.34 million operations per second. For machine learning workloads, the CPU supports AVX-512 and AVX_VNNI, achieving top-tier text generation speeds of 54.82 tokens per second on medium 7B LLM models.

Given the high density of 80 dedicated physical cores and massive 9.4 TB local storage, the F80ads_v7 offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for compute-heavy and storage-intensive workloads without requiring external disk attachments. The lack of hyperthreading ensures predictable, dedicated execution. This configuration is highly suited for high-performance computing, large-scale database operations, heavy web serving, and CPU-based machine learning inference.
